newsitem.title: UK: Racal gets UK contract worth 65 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Racal gets UK contract worth 65 mln stg.

text.p: Racal Electronics Plc said on Monday it was awarded a 10-year UK government contract worth about 65 million stg.
Under the Private Finance Initiative contract, Racal will operate the Metropolitan Telephone Service (MTS) on behalf of the Central Computer and Telecommunications Agency (CCTA).
Racal will provide managed voice services to government departments, primarily in central London.
The contract replaces a number of agreements the CCTA has in place with various suppliers, Racal said in a statement.
Racal will assume ownership of the existing infrastructure including 71 private telephone exchanges in central London.
Full implementation will take place over 18 months and includes taking over existing maintenance agreements presently managed by British Telecommunications Plc, Racal said.
